title: Zombie Apocalypse Survival Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: In the midst of a global zombie apocalypse, step into the role of humanity's last hope. Guard the only cure as you navigate through abandoned hospitals, fight your way through sewers teeming with zombies, and scale treacherous heights. This thrilling adventure culminates in a nerve-racking helicopter flight over a devastated city, where you’ll face both the undead and armed mercenaries in a final showdown. Ready your skills and strategy for an unforgettable battle to save the world.
